title: 黄仁勋回归首日：没带电脑，先向员工要第二次机会？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Man, the story that just keeps on giving, tells about this video that you've seen that was an inside-in-turn video video.
segments.zh: 这事真是没完没了，说的就是你看到的这段内部视频。

segments.en: So I think now these videos are now circulating on X and social media as well, but it was sent to me
segments.zh: 现在这些视频在X和社交媒体上流传，但它是有人发给我的。

segments.en: by a senior source inside of Nvidia and Jensen Wang walked into the endeavor building.
segments.zh: 来自英伟达内部一位资深人士，黄仁勋走进了Endeavor大楼。

segments.en: There are basically two buildings at HQ. So he was in the endeavor building just after you go through the security and into the lobby.
segments.zh: 总部基本有两栋楼，他就在Endeavor楼，过了安检进大厅就是。

segments.en: And there was staff on all floors. It has an atrium with different levels to leaning over the railings.
segments.zh: 各层都有员工，中庭有不同楼层，大家探身靠在栏杆上。

segments.en: And there was chanting of like Jensen, Jensen, Jensen.
And he kind of had a hand on his heart.
segments.zh: 他有点把手放在心口上。

segments.en: And you guys went through the quotes, but he said, thank you to the staff for the second chance.
segments.zh: 你们已经聊过那些话了，但他对员工说，谢谢大家给他第二次机会。

segments.en: He didn't have a computer, so the IT department's going to have to get in one.
segments.zh: 他没带电脑，所以IT部门得给他配一台。

segments.en: But the key thing is the quote that I am going to be a better CEO the second time around quote.
segments.zh: 但关键是这句话：第二次我会做个更好的CEO。

segments.en: And all of this has happened very quickly. The team has detailed some of the reporting about the board taking pretty fast action Sunday.
segments.zh: 这一切发生得非常快。团队详细报道了董事会周日的快速行动。

segments.en: There's more reporting being done, but it kind of happened in isolation between the board, Jensen, and the president of the United States, as you know.
segments.zh: 还有更多报道正在进行，但如你所知，这只是在董事会、Jensen和美国总统之间孤立发生的。

segments.en: And the market reaction speaks for itself, doesn't it?
segments.zh: 市场反应不言自明，不是吗？

segments.en: On how this is being received. Oh, it really does.
segments.zh: 关于这如何被接收。哦，确实如此。
